statement.p: Compute the curl of the vector field \vec{F} = \left(2x+4y\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+\left(4z-2y\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+\left(2z+4x\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}

solution.me: \mbox{curl}\vec{F} = \left| \begin{array}{ccc} \quad\vec i\quad \amp \quad\vec j\quad \amp \quad\vec k\quad \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial y} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\ \quad 2x+4y\quad \amp \quad 4z-2y\quad \amp \quad 2z+4x\quad \end{array} \right| = -4\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}-4\,\mathit{\vec k}.
